The court is a rectangle marked out with lines 40 mm wide (Laws of Badminton 5.0 (2), in force 2025-04-26, Clause 1.1).
A shuttle landing on a line is in, not out: under Laws of Badminton 5.0 (2), in force 2025-04-26, Clause 13.3.1, it is a fault only if, in play, the shuttle lands outside the boundaries of the court, i.e. not on or within the boundary lines. Law 17.4 (Laws of Badminton 5.0 (2)) has the line judge indicate whether a shuttle landed 'in' or 'out' on the line(s) assigned, and Instructions to Technical Officials Clause 8.6 says not to call or signal until the shuttle has touched the floor or anything outside the court boundaries (except a player) — these describe the line judge's duty and timing around the in/out call but do not themselves define the on-the-line result.
